title: HB Tweaks - Logs
description: Saves the incomming chat texts into an individual directory (logs_chat). Originally made for roleplay servers but useable everywhere.
body:
# HB Tweaks - Logs

Very simple mod doing one simple thing:
- Saves the chat messages in individual (per-session) log files in the "logs_chat" directory and saves all chat logs ever in the all.log file.

It was originally made for the herobrine.fr French roleplay server, but it can be used by anybody.
